href="#grok-imagine-image-quality-retirement-on-november-2">grok-imagine-image-quality retirement on November 2</a></h3></span><p>On November 2, 2026, <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-image-quality</code></span> is retired. Requests to the slug will be served by <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-image-2.0</code></span> with <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">quality</code></span> set to <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">low</code></span>, with no change to the request or response shape and at a lower per-image price. <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-image</code></span> (1.0) is not affected. See the <a href="/developers/migration/imagine-image-quality-nov-2" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">migration guide</a>.</p></div></div><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="august" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#august">August</a></h2></span><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">August 28<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="imagine-image-api-updates" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#imagine-image-api-updates">Imagine image API updates</a></h3></span><ul>
<li><strong>Auto quality.</strong> The <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">quality</code></span> parameter on <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-image-2.0</code></span> now accepts <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">auto</code></span>, and the default when <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">quality</code></span> is omitted has moved from <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">medium</code></span> to <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">auto</code></span>. Auto currently uses <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">low</code></span> for image generation and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">medium</code></span> for image editing. Images are billed at the quality they are served at. Pass <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">low</code></span> or <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">medium</code></span> explicitly to pin a specific quality. See <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/images/generation#quality" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Image Generation</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Five reference images.</strong> Image editing now accepts up to 5 source images per request (was 3). See <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/images/multi-image-editing" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Multi-Image Editing</a>.</li>
<li><strong>New aspect ratios.</strong> Image generation and editing accept <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">21:9</code></span> (cinematic widescreen) and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">5:2</code></span> (wide banners). See <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/images/generation#aspect-ratio" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Image Generation</a>.</li>
</ul></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">August 12<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="grok-46" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#grok-46">Grok 4.6</a></h3></span><p>Grok 4.6, SpaceXAI&#x27;s frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API. It has a 500k context window, text and image inputs with text-only output, and no text output limit. Pricing is $2 / $0.50 / $6 per 1M tokens (input / cached input / output) below 200k prompt tokens, and $4 / $1 / $12 above. Reasoning effort supports low, medium, high (default), and xhigh. See the <a href="/developers/grok-4-6" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Grok 4.6 overview</a> and the <a href="https://x.ai/news/grok-4-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">announcement</a>.</p></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">August 11<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="grok-bot" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#grok-bot">Grok Bot</a></h3></span><p>Grok Bot is now available. Durable AI teammates that work on a persistent cloud computer, with messaging, approvals, connectors, and routines. Text-to-video on this model runs as text-to-image then image-to-video under the hood. See <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/video/generation" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Video Generation</a>, <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/video/image-to-video" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Image-to-Video</a>, and <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/video/reference-to-video" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Reference-to-Video</a>.</p></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">July 29<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="grok-voice-think-fast-20-is-available" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#grok-voice-think-fast-20-is-available">Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 is available</a></h3></span><p><span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-voice-think-fast-2.0</code></span> is now available with Speech to Speech. <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-voice-latest</code></span> will route to this model starting August 5, 2026. To get started, see the <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/audio/speech-to-speech" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Speech to Speech docs</a>. For more details, see our <a href="https://x.ai/news/grok-voice-think-fast-2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">announcement</a>.</p></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">July 23<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="adjustable-vad-threshold-for-speech-to-text" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#adjustable-vad-threshold-for-speech-to-text">Adjustable VAD threshold for Speech to Text</a></h3></span><p>Speech to Text now accepts a <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">vad_threshold</code></span> parameter (streaming query param and batch multipart field) to tune the voice-activity gate that skips non-speech audio. Lower values transcribe quieter or noisier speech — useful for narrowband telephony — and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">0</code></span> disables the gate. See the <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/audio/speech-to-text" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Speech to Text docs</a>.</p></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">July 17<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="grok-45-available-in-the-eu" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#grok-45-available-in-the-eu">Grok 4.5 available in the EU</a></h3></span><p>Grok 4.5 is now available in the API console for EU users. See the <a href="/developers/grok-4-5" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Grok 4.5 overview</a>.</p></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">July 8<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="grok-45" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#grok-45">Grok 4.5</a></h3></span><p>Grok 4.5, SpaceXAI&#x27;s model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API. Priced at $2 / 1M input tokens and $6 / 1M output tokens, with configurable reasoning effort (low, medium, or high; default high). See the <a href="/developers/grok-4-5" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Grok 4.5 overview</a> and the <a href="https://x.ai/news/grok-4-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">announcement</a>.</p></div></div><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="june" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#june">June</a></h2></span><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">June 15<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="priority-processing" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#priority-processing">Priority Processing</a></h3></span><p>You can now request higher scheduling priority per request by setting <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">service_tier: &quot;priority&quot;</code></span> on text inference endpoints (Chat Completions and Responses). The response&#x27;s <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">service_tier</code></span> field reports the tier actually applied, and priority rates are billed only when priority is used. For more details, see the <a href="/developers/advanced-api-usage/priority-processing" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Priority Processing docs</a>.</p></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">June 10<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="public-urls-and-files-api--imagine-integration" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#public-urls-and-files-api--imagine-integration">Public URLs and Files API ↔ Imagine integration</a></h3></span><ul>
<li><strong>Public URLs for Files</strong> — turn any file in your <a href="/developers/files" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Files API</a> storage into a permanent, unauthenticated URL that anyone can open, embed, or share. Revocable at any time, or set an auto-expiry between 1 hour and 30 days. See the <a href="/developers/files/public-urls" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Public URLs docs</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Reference stored files as Imagine inputs</strong> — substitute <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">image_file_id</code></span>, <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">video_file_id</code></span>, or <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">reference_image_file_ids</code></span> for URL inputs across every Imagine endpoint, with no need to re-upload bytes or make the file public. See <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/imagine/files/inputs" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Imagine → Files API Integration</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Persist Imagine outputs to Files</strong> — set <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">storage_options</code></span> on any Imagine request to save the generated asset to your Files storage; pair with <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">storage_options.public_url</code></span> to publish a shareable link in one round trip. See <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/imagine/files/outputs" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Imagine → Files API Integration</a>.</li>
</ul></div></div><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="may" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-balance text-2xl leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-3xl mb-4 mt-12"><a class="not-prose" href="#may">May</a></h2></span><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">May 29<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="smart-turn-for-streaming-stt" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#smart-turn-for-streaming-stt">Smart Turn for Streaming STT</a></h3></span><p>The streaming Speech to Text API now supports Smart Turn end-of-turn detection. When enabled via the <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">smart_turn</code></span> query parameter, an ML model predicts whether the speaker has finished their thought at silence boundaries — reducing false endpointing during dictation, number sequences, and mid-sentence pauses. Use <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">smart_turn_timeout</code></span> to set a maximum silence fallback. For more details, see the <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/audio/speech-to-text#smart-turn" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Smart Turn docs</a>.</p></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">May 29<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="context-compaction" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#context-compaction">Context Compaction</a></h3></span><p>The Context Compaction API is now available. You can shrink long conversations into a shorter context and reuse it in follow-up requests for lower cost, faster time-to-first-token, and sharper responses on long agent loops. For more details, see the <a href="/developers/advanced-api-usage/context-compaction" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Context Compaction docs</a>.</p><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="websocket-responses-api-mode" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#websocket-responses-api-mode">WebSocket Responses API Mode</a></h3></span><p>WebSocket Responses API mode is now available. Drive the Responses API over a single, long-lived WebSocket connection for lower end-to-end latency on tool-heavy agent workloads. For more details, see the <a href="/developers/advanced-api-usage/websocket-mode" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">WebSocket Mode docs</a>.</p></div></div><div class="relative mt-12 grid grid-cols-[5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-6 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-x-8 [&amp;_h3]:!mt-0"><div class="text-muted top-(--topbar-height) sticky -mb-24 self-start pb-24 pt-[0.2rem] text-sm tabular-nums"><div class="relative">May 27<span aria-hidden="true" class="bg-muted absolute left-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] top-[0.4rem] size-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full sm:left-[calc(100%+1rem)]"></span></div></div><div class="min-w-0"><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="image-search-in-web-search" class="scroll-mt-28 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary font-display text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl mb-3 mt-10"><a class="not-prose" href="#image-search-in-web-search">Image Search in Web Search</a></h3></span><p>Web Search now supports explicitly searching for images. Both <a href="/developers/tools/overview" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">server-side tools</a> and client-side function tools are also now supported in batch requests.
